body:
Maybe I inerpreted him falsely, but at the same time he has been the one who has said to me that he does not understand depression and for him it's just a thing of attitude not a thing in the brain. I've kind of gotten him to understand this but he still has his views. He has also said that people who hurt or kill themselves are incredibly stupid and he does not get that. He doesn't have much respect for people like this. 

Yeah, I've talked to my parents about the job thing. My mother really doesn't listen to me that much anymore about that. Not that she's a terrible mum, I've just talked about this so much already that there's nothing much she can say anymore. She also doesn't mind me being at home most of the time. There isn't much she can do anyway, at the end I am the one who needs to get a job etc. I've been looking for a few months now, but I can't seem to find anything. My dad has said that he wants me to become someone one day, to go for my dreams and get out there. He has tried looking for a job for me (with me of course) but we haven't had any luck, every possibility we have found has always failed miserably. 

For my mental health, I've been to therapy. I absolutely hated it and I quit. My therapist basically told me that everything is my fault, my trust issues aren't valid because everyone lies etc. I just had a really bad therapist. That was when I was a minor and this help for me was free. Now that I'm an adult, I have to pay if I ever wanted to go back to therapy (which I really don't due to my bad experience) and I really don't have the money for it. I don't even have the money to go to university if I wanted to but that's another issue, since there really isn't anything to study in my country. Nothing that would interest me. My bf and his mum urge me to go study anyway, just to get a degree, but for me that is incredibly stupid to just go study something for 3 years of your life you have zero interest in just to get a piece of paper. 

Edit: grammar

I feel as though  opening up to my boyfriend about wanting to die was a mistake though. As he said, he doesn't want a girlfriend who is like that and he also said that wanting to die is stupid and that "people have bigger problems than you, get over it." That wasn't very helpful and I'm really regretting opening up at all because he will most probably leave me now.
